title: UNI students win Gold national advertising award
summary_en: A group of UNI students came home with the competition’s highest honors at the National American Advertising Awards, the advertising industry’s largest competition, which attracts more than 25,000 entries each year from both industry professionals and students.
title_cn: UNI students win Gold national advertising award

title: UNI athletic training student becomes life-saving donor for leukemia patient
summary_en: UNI Master of Athletic Training student Max Mullis traveled to Chicago to donate stem cells to a 73-year-old leukemia patient.
title_cn: UNI athletic training student becomes life-saving donor for leukemia patient

title: How Curris became the heart of business at UNI
summary_en: For 35 years, the Curris Business Building has been the heart of business at UNI. Now, the spaces that shaped generations of students are helping define the future of business education.
title_cn: How Curris became the heart of business at UNI
